# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 02 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Policy Update

- **15-month wait-out period for private property owners buying HDB resale flats removed** - The Government has removed the 15-month wait-out period with immediate effect, allowing eligible private residential property owners to right-size into an HDB resale flat without waiting, following signs that the HDB resale market has stabilised after several years of rapid price growth. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/15-month-period-removed-for-private-property-owners-buying-hdb-resale/)

- **Property agents must meet new transaction requirement from 2027; CEA extends registrations to three years** - From 1 January 2027, property agents in Singapore will need to complete at least three qualifying property transactions over a three-year registration period to remain registered, as part of new CEA regulatory changes announced on 28 July 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/property-agents-must-meet-new-transaction-requirement-from-2027-cea-extends-registrations-to-three-years/)

## New Launch & Resale Market

- **Dunearn House sells 56% of units at launch, with family-sized homes leading demand** - The 380-unit Dunearn House sold 212 units (56%) during its launch weekend at an average price of S$3,140 psf, marking a solid debut as the first private residential development within the upcoming Bukit Timah Turf City precinct. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-sells-212-units-averaging-3140-psf-at-launch/)

- **Condo resale volumes rebounded in June 2026 as buyers returned to the secondary market** - Singapore's private resale condominium market remained steady in June 2026, with prices holding largely flat while transaction volumes picked up, reflecting a period of stabilisation with few signs of either strong acceleration or a slowdown. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-volumes-rebounded-in-june-2026-as-buyers-returned-to-the-secondary-market/)

## HDB & Rental Trends

- **Survey reveals the typical million-dollar HDB buyer in Singapore** - A PropNex survey of 110 million-dollar HDB resale deals in 2025 shows that buyers are predominantly PMET professionals in their 30s and 40s, retirees downsizing from private homes, and buyers who paid no cash-over-valuation at all. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/a-new-survey-reveals-the-typical-million-dollar-hdb-buyer-in-singapore-including-a-surprising-buying-trend/)

- **Older leasehold condos are producing higher rental yields — but age isn't the real reason** - Rental yields for two- and three-bedroom 99-year leasehold condos rise with a project's age because prices cool faster than rents, while freehold condos show no such pattern, based on a lifespan-wide analysis of Singapore's private housing data. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/older-leasehold-condos-producing-higher-rental-yields-age-isnt-the-real-reason/)
